content:
alex: Heads-up — PR #26144 is ready but CI is flaky on mac-e2e.
priya: Can we land before the maintenance blackout at 18:00 UTC? It's a small change (switch default timeout) and we need it in prod for the rollout.
alex: If CI stabilizes in next 20m we can try. Otherwise we should defer to the next rebase window to avoid touching the deploy during blackout.
tara: @priya can you add a short description of the risk in the PR and mark it "canary-safe" so we can pick it for manual canary if needed?
priya: Sure, added note and flagged as canary-safe. Also pinged @jordan for a second pair of eyes on the DB migration bits.
jordan: Looking now — small change, LGTM from code perspective. Only ask: please add a smoke test in staging after merge.
ci-bot: Pipeline 11234 failed on mac-e2e — flaky test suite "ui:cart-checkout". Rerun available.
alex: Ok, let's try a single rerun. If it passes we'll queue for a quick canary deploy at 16:40 UTC, otherwise we hold.
priya: Started rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun 11234.1 succeeded.
alex: Nice. @tara can you approve so we can merge and trigger canary? We want to avoid merging during the 18:00-20:00 blackout window.
tara: Approving now. Also adding note to release doc about manual rollback steps.
priya: Merged at 16:12 UTC and queued canary.
ci-bot: Deploy to canary cluster started (canary-3). ETA ~8m.
jordan: I'll monitor logs. If anything spikes, we revert the canary and postpone full rollout.
alex: Thanks everyone. If canary looks good by 16:35 we plan full rollout at 16:45, still clear of blackout.
priya: Canary looks clean at +10m. No obvious errors in logs.
ci-bot: Canary check OK — metrics within expected thresholds.
alex: Rolling to prod at 16:46 UTC.
priya: Prod rollout started, watch for DB migration warnings.
jordan: No errors seen, latency ok. Marking as done.
tara: Great. Closing the loop: created follow-up ticket to investigate flaky mac-e2e test.
alex: 👍 thanks all — saved us from hitting the blackout.
